title: Trainee Content Creator
description:
1. Develop, plan, and create engaging content for social media platforms, websites, blogs, and other digital channels. 2. Write clear, compelling copy for posts, captions, and marketing campaigns. 3. Research industry-related topics and stay updated on digital trends. 4. Collaborate with marketing, design, and product teams to align content with brand guidelines. 5. Manage and grow social media pages by posting regularly and interacting with the audience. 6. Analyze content performance using analytics tools and optimize future content accordingly. 7. Ensure all content is consistent with the brands tone, style, and objectives

 1)Highly creative with excellent analytical abilities. 2)In-depth knowledge of various social media platforms, best practices and website analytics. 3)Up-to-date on the latest trends and technologies in digital marketing.
